### What changes for the player or contributor?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

### How was it checked?

Separate automated/build checks from game and headset observations. Include the
exact build, runtime and relevant character or menu. "Not tested in a headset"
is useful information; please do not mark untested behavior as fixed.

### Attribution and scope

Credit reused code and keep its notices. Do not include game assets, private
logs, account IDs, binary memory captures or credentials. Describe any changed
defaults, migration or rollback steps that players need.
